subject: Handoff canvas: VPC/on-prem readiness & resourcing decision
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff canvas: VPC/on-prem readiness & resourcing decision

Team —

Following the VPC/on-prem intake this morning, I pulled together a short handoff canvas and a concrete set of asks so we can reach a resourcing decision by Friday. Attached: vpc-readiness-matrix.xlsx and pilot-scope-proposal.pdf. Key context: ACME (platform@acme.com) is targeting a Q3 pilot that requires VPC-isolated control plane + customer-managed HSM for key material. They will not accept hosted shared tenancy for the pilot.

Top-level ask (3 decisions required):
1) Pilot scope: approve a small pilot (1 customer, limited feature set — generation + embeddings, no streaming) or push back to offer hosted-with-contract? (decision point: pilot_yes / pilot_no)
2) SLA and support tier: do we commit to a provisional 99.9% SLO for the pilot under Dedicated capacity (ops & SRE staffing needed)?
3) Evidence & ownership: who owns the security evidence pack (SOC2 artifacts, KMS attestations) for this customer during pilot?

Resourcing note (high level):
- Proposal in sheet: ops-headcount-ask.csv (see tab "heads") — recommends 0.4 FTE Eng (runtime), 0.5 FTE Ops/Infra, 0.2 FTE Security for 3 months.
- If leadership approves a provisional exception to our standard gating (which normally requires full Dedicated onboarding runbook + 1.0 FTE sustain), we can scope down to the numbers above and run a tight pilot.

Risks / trade-offs:
- Reduced staffing increases operational risk; we need a fallback policy (automatic switch to hosted variant) if availability dips below thresholds.
- Onboarding time: network peering and HSM integration estimated 3–5 weeks given current infra queues.

Deliverables I need from each of you by EOD Thursday so I can present to Laura Friday AM:
- Karthik: short tech assessment (1 page) confirming whether the runtime changes for HSM/KMS require a model recompile or runtime patch and an estimate of engineering hours.
- Neha: confirm Ops availability and whether we can carve the 0.5 FTE from current sprint without delaying other pilots.
- Rishi: security list of minimum evidence for a provisional pilot and proposed owner for collating artifacts.
- Laura: decision authority on provisional exception and quick guidance on SLA commitment.

If helpful, I can set a 30-min sync Thursday to review the assessment artifacts — link to draft plan included in related_links.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Group Product Manager — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vpc-readiness-matrix.xlsx (matrix, tabs: network, storage, security), pilot-scope-proposal.pdf (2pg)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff canvas: VPC/on-prem readiness & resourcing decision

Soojin —

Thanks for the concise canvas. Quick notes after scanning the attachments:
- HSM/KMS: integration surface is limited to key unwrap calls and plugin-level config. We should not need a model recompile, but we will need a runtime patch to add a KMS-provider hook and a short validation harness. Estimate: 3–5 dev days + 2 days QA + 1 day for deployment automation (total ~1.0 engineering week).
- Network: if ACME insists on private peering + strict egress rules, expect additional infra work ~1–2 weeks depending on ticket priority.

Questions for Neha: is there a standing ops oncall buffer we can tap for the pilot? If not, we should be explicit about the support window.

I can draft the 1-page tech assessment by EOD Thursday.

—Karthik

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff canvas: VPC/on-prem readiness & resourcing decision

Soojin / Karthik —

We reviewed the ops-headcount-ask.csv. Short answer: current sprint capacity is tight. We can support a pilot but not without making trade-offs elsewhere. Suggested approach:

- Approve pilot with a strict 6-week acceptance window and a staffed "on-demand" escalation rota (two folks in rotation, estimated 0.5 FTE over 6 weeks). We can backfill from upcoming infra tasks but that will push noncritical infra tickets by ~3 weeks.
- We cannot guarantee a 99.9% SLO with the proposed lean staffing. Recommend offering ACME a provisional 99.5% for pilot period with clear escalation and a pre-agreed fallback to hosted.

I attached a short CSV tab (ops-headcount-ask.csv) showing current commitments and the proposed rota. Also: we need a single point person to own collecting SOC2/KMS evidence — security will not compile that for a pilot without an owner.

If the leadership team approves the provisional exception and the 6-week window, we can start onboarding work Monday next week.

-Neha

On Wed, May 19, 2027 at 09:03, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:

> 
> Thanks for the concise canvas...

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff canvas: VPC/on-prem readiness & resourcing decision

Team —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clarity in asks. Decision: I approve a provisional pilot exception for ACME under the following constraints:

1) Pilot window: 6 weeks.
2) Support: provisioned rota as Neha proposed (0.5 FTE over pilot).
3) SLO: offer provisional 99.5% for the pilot; we will not promise 99.9% until we staff to the standard gating.
4) Evidence owner: Rishi — you will compile the minimum security pack and maintain the artifact folder.

Next steps: Soojin, schedule a 30-min decision kick-off today at 4pm and invite ACME (platform@acme.com) for a short sync on scope. Use the doc in related_links as the working plan; get a signed mutual action plan (MAP) on scope and rollback policy before onboarding.

I will escalate resource impacts to VPs if we see more than two concurrent pilots in the next quarter.

Thanks —
Laura
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
